labels.description: Reads retained worktree sidecar without checking current isolation mode. With isolation off and Actor writes in main, attribution incorrectly reports target.py as unwritten by inspecting retained worktree.

fix_mapping.explanation: Same helper and sidecar-read site: fix inserts _wt_isolation_enabled early return immediately before the corresponding read. Returning None selects main for disabled isolation. Introducing head added this helper; parent correctly observes main in the supplied scenario.
